simulatedPerson.name: stillness
simulatedPerson.hiddenRule: Likes still frames with empty space or a single figure (85%); dislikes implied motion and dense frames (10%); otherwise 35%.

interpretation.summary: Across 82 stills from 35 films, the clearest thread is stillness.

sections.title: Stillness
sections.text: The stills you liked consistently share single figure (22 of 37 liked), and more loosely stillness (25 of 50 liked). Stillness, spare composition and restrained colour slow the image down; small details and the relation between a figure and empty space take on weight. You can see it in 12 Angry Men: Juror 3, Amélie: Amélie in the café and Double Indemnity: Phyllis Dietrichson at the top of the stairs. By contrast, you did not like 12 Angry Men: The jurors around the table (stillness, but not single figure) or 2001: A Space Odyssey: Frank Poole adrift in space beside the EVA pod (single figure, but not stillness).

claims.statement: The stills you liked consistently share single figure (22 of 37 liked), and more loosely stillness (25 of 50 liked).

sections.title: How sure this is
sections.text: Some characteristics cannot yet be told apart because they occur in nearly the same stills: close-up with single figure and intimate with single figure. There are too few examples to say anything about dust (2 judged), rim light (2 judged) and extreme close-up (2 judged). All of this compares your own likes with your own dislikes among 82 stills; it is not a comparison with anyone else.
